source.method: Cached text responses retrieved from the official Horizons API; the cache files under data/validation/horizons/ are the reference data.

reference: JPL Horizons API observer-table output; DE441

engine.coordinate_system: MOON_ME, east/north/up, azimuth clockwise from north

methodology.reference_values: Cached Horizons azimuth/elevation for each site/body/time.
methodology.generated_values: Production geometric positions and a separate SPICE apparent reproduction.
methodology.difference: Angular separation of unit vectors; geometric elevation absolute error and above-horizon sign agreement are also reported.

automated_criteria.purpose: Computational consistency check only; not scientific approval.
